items.en_title: Itapecerica (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 4 #08
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itapecerica (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 817,009.20; proposals close Dec 4, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
